subject: Data protection questionnaire and DPA annex — Bioscribe RFI
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bioscribe.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bioscribe.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Data protection questionnaire and DPA annex — initial RFI

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our procurement process we need an evidence package and responses to a short set of questions focused on cross-border transfers and the DPA annex. Our procurement team attached a standard RFI template (attached) — the key asks are: 

- 1) Is Redwood able to commit to a DPA annex including standard international transfer mechanisms (DPF/SCCs or UK Addendum) and how quickly can you sign?
- 2) Where does data move (regions), and what are your subprocessors for inference and logging?
- 3) Describe the technical and organisational measures specific to cross-border exports, including any supplementary safeguards you rely on for transfers.
- 4) Can you provide SOC 2 Type II report summary and the scope for logs/retention?
- 5) For regulated workloads (PHI or pseudonymised health data), what deployment options (Private/VPC, on-prem) are available and typical timelines?
- 6) Please provide a short DPF narrative suitable for our EU privacy team.

Attached: bioscribe-rfi-template.xlsx

We are hoping to close the vendor selection by the end of next week (Jan 20). Would you be able to provide a preliminary packet and suggest a 30-minute call with your security contact?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement
Bioscribe Therapeutics

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bioscribe.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data protection questionnaire and DPA annex — initial RFI

Hi Samantha — thanks for sending this over and for the timeline. I can confirm we will assemble a short evidence pack and a DPF narrative by Jan 18, and we can share a redlined DPA annex for your legal team to review.

Quick answers up front:
- We support Dedicated and Private deployments for regulated workloads; Private (VPC) onboarding typically runs 4–8 weeks depending on network approvals.
- Core inference and logging run in our hosted regions in US and EU; we maintain subprocessors for cloud infra and managed logging — I will include the current subprocessor list.
- We will attach a SOC 2 Type II summary and a short DPF narrative.

I'll loop in Laura (security/legal) and Aditya (risk/compliance) to review the templates and produce the attachments. Could you confirm whether you need an executed DPA annex before running a short technical POC, or if a redline is sufficient for now?

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 13:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data protection questionnaire and DPA annex — internal: draft package

Ben / Aditya — I reviewed the RFI template and prepared: (1) a one-page DPF narrative (redwood-dpf-summary.pdf), (2) a redline of our standard DPA annex tailored to transfer safeguards (dpa-annex-redline.docx), and (3) an excerpted SOC 2 Type II summary (SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf). Key notes: 

- Transfers: We rely on SCCs (post-2024 European Commission standard clauses) for EU->US transfers, supplemented by documented technical measures: encryption in transit (TLS1.3), customer-configurable key management for Private customers, strict access controls, and export controls on logs. The DPF narrative explains lawful transfer mechanisms and risk mitigations.
- Subprocessors: primary compute is with our managed GPU fleets (third-party cloud providers); managed logging and analytics are with Redwood-managed services — full subprocessor list attached as a separate export (we will provide CSV on request).
- Retention: default inference logs retained 30 days; configurable retention windows for Dedicated/Private customers.
- For PHI: recommend Private deployment; offer an on-prem package for air-gapped requirements with a longer lead time.

Please review the attached drafts and flag anything that requires escalated legal sign-off. I recommend we provide the redline to Bioscribe now and propose a 30-min security sync next week (include our security engineer).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Security & Privacy | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: redwood-dpf-summary.pdf; dpa-annex-redline.docx; SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bioscribe.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jan 2028 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data protection questionnaire and DPA annex — Bioscribe RFI response packet

Hi Samantha — attaching the evidence packet we discussed. Summary below and attachments are included for your privacy and procurement teams.

Summary (key items):
- DPF narrative: short explanation of transfer mechanisms and supplemental safeguards (see redwood-dpf-summary.pdf).
- DPA annex: redline of our standard DPA with notes on SCCs and optional UK Addendum (dpa-annex-redline.docx).
- SOC 2: high-level summary and scope indicating logs and operational controls (SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf).
- Subprocessors: inventory export available on request; compute + logging subprocessors listed in the DPA annex.
- Deployment options: Hosted (fast onboarding), Dedicated (reserved capacity), Private/VPC and on-prem (for regulated workloads). Typical Private onboarding 4–8 weeks; on-prem projects scoped separately.

Attachments: redwood-dpf-summary.pdf; dpa-annex-redline.docx; SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf; bioscribe-rfi-template.xlsx

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-1428), placeholder DocuSign link for review.

Next steps: 1) Let me know if a signed DPA annex is required before POC; 2) If helpful, let's schedule a 30-minute technical/security sync next week — I can bring our security engineer to discuss transfer safeguards and deployment options.

Best regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bioscribe.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bioscribe.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jan 2028 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Data protection questionnaire and DPA annex — Bioscribe RFI response packet

Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. We received the packet and the redline looks comprehensive. Our EU privacy team will review the DPF narrative and the SCC references; security would like to see the subprocessor CSV you mentioned.

We are OK to run a short POC while the legal teams exchange DPA redlines, provided we have the SOC 2 summary and the deployment options documented (which you included). Please go ahead and propose two time slots for the technical/security sync — Friday or early next week would be best.

Also, please share the subprocessor list export and the internal contact for your security engineer so we can add them to the call invite.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.
Samantha
Head of Procurement | Bioscribe Therapeutics
